<details>
<summary><b>🏗️ How I build a platform</b> · the architecture behind my projects</summary>
<br />

One NestJS API serves the web app, the mobile app and the Super Admin dashboard, with MySQL underneath and AI/LLM features behind their own service layer.

<p align="center">
  <img src="assets/architecture.svg" width="100%" alt="Web app, mobile app and Super Admin dashboard call one NestJS API, which talks to MySQL through Prisma or TypeORM, to AI/LLM APIs and to WebSockets; auth with JWT, guards and roles; documented with Swagger; shipped through Git, CI/CD, Docker and Nginx on Linux" />
</p>

| Need | Approach |
| --- | --- |
| Three clients (web, mobile, admin) on one backend | A single modular NestJS API with shared DTOs and validation |
| Admins must see and control everything | A Super Admin dashboard in React / Next.js on the same API |
| AI-powered features | LLM calls isolated in their own service, so the rest of the app stays simple |
| Schema changes without surprises | Prisma / TypeORM migrations, reviewed like any other code |
| Different users, different powers | JWT auth with guards and role-based access |

</details>
